paper_title: NExtLong Toward Effective Long-Context Training without Long Documents
caption: NExtLong reduces the model's dependence on proximal text. We calculated the degree of dependence on proximal text (the last third of the text) for different methods when completing the LongQA task. It can be observed that NExtLong significantly reduces the model's dependence on proximal text.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the short-dependence attention weight associated with different methods. The horizontal axis represents the categories labeled as "Methods," which include Standard, ICLM, KNN, Quest, and NExtLong. The vertical axis indicates the attention weight, labeled as "Attention Weight," with a linear scale ranging from 0.80 to 0.90, with tick marks at intervals of 0.02. Each bar is uniformly colored light blue, and the heights of the bars represent the attention weight values for each method. The approximate value for the Standard method is 0.865, for ICLM it is 0.855, for KNN is just above 0.86, and same value for Quest, and for NExtLong it is 0.825. The bars are not specifically sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized with different shading, bolding, or annotations. The chart includes a legend titled "Short-Dependence Attention Weight" to clarify the meaning of the bar colors.
